limitations.text: Verifier decode of the raw CSV (Windows driver, 2 s interval, ~2 min of K7 item 3, one 20M-token E10 run): 55 busy GPU samples (util >= 50%): median SM clock 2008 MHz (1137-2294), max 78.2 C, 0/55 with a thermal-slowdown bit (0x20/0x40). But only 1/55 shows the SW power-cap bit (0x4); 46/55 report 0x1 and 8/55 0x400. So 'not thermally limited' holds on this sample, but 'power-limited' is not shown. It is a campaign sample, not an SQ79 result.
